# paperclip_board_key (Ephemeral Resource)

Produces a Paperclip board key token only during apply for ephemeral or write-only delivery.

## Example Usage

```terraform
ephemeral "paperclip_board_key" "board_token" {
  name       = "automation-board-key"
  generation = 1
  applying   = tofu.applying
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `applying` (Boolean) Indicates whether the apply phase is actively running (e.g. tofu.applying). When false, credential minting is deferred.
- `expires_at` (String) Optional RFC3339 expiration timestamp.
- `generation` (Number) Monotonic generation number.
- `key_id` (String) Managed Paperclip board key ID.
- `name` (String) Board key name.
- `requested_company_id` (String) Optional company ID to scope board key activity records.

### Read-Only

- `token` (String, Sensitive) Ephemeral bearer token delivered only to an ephemeral or write-only consumer.
